dependency_order: A `subtask` seeds its parent condition and inherited invariants before contribution details, delegated paths, and verification (§4.4).

slots.name: Summary
slots.description: The contribution and the parent condition it verifies, without a separate product outcome.

slots.name: Parent task
slots.description: Exactly one authoritative parent task reference.

slots.name: Named completion condition
slots.description: Exactly one stable completion-condition ID from the parent task, with its exact meaning and scope preserved.

slots.name: Contribution
slots.description: The implementation, test, documentation, data, or operational contribution this subtask supplies.

slots.name: Boundaries and invariants
slots.description: Local scope, applicable inherited invariant IDs, relevant failure limits, and excluded work.

slots.name: Delegated path details
slots.description: Detail for each sad path delegated by the parent, or "None" with a reason. The detail preserves the parent's user-visible outcome.

slots.name: Definition of done
slots.description: One local closure contract that verifies the named parent completion condition.

slots.name: Verification evidence
slots.description: Artifact, environment, inputs, method, observable result, and link back to the parent condition.
